Package gui

Class ServerPortFrameController

java.lang.Object
gui.ServerPortFrameController
public class ServerPortFrameController extends Object
FXML controller for the server control panel (ServerPort.fxml).

shows the port field, client table, connection log, and simulation log. the static helper methods (addClient(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), markClientDisconnected(java.lang.String), logSimulation(java.lang.String), etc.) are safe to call from any thread; they all marshal updates to the JavaFX thread via Platform.runLater(java.lang.Runnable).

      public void toggleTheme(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      toggles the control panel between the light and dark "Night Trail" themes by adding or removing the dark-mode style class on the scene root. the button glyph flips between a moon (currently light) and a sun (currently dark).
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • emptyState

      private static javafx.scene.Node emptyState()
      builds the designed empty state for the clients table: a pine vector monitor icon, a short headline, and a hint, replacing the bare "No clients connected." text. styled via the empty-title / empty-hint classes in ServerPort.css.

    • addClient

      public static void addClient(String ip, String host)

    • markClientDisconnected

      public static void markClientDisconnected(String ip)
      removes the row for the given IP from the client table and logs the disconnection. safe to call from any thread.

    • logSimulation

      public static void logSimulation(String message)
      appends a line to the simulation log. falls back to stdout if the controller isn't initialised yet (e.g. during server startup). safe to call from any thread.
      Parameters:
      message - the simulation line to append; a newline is added automatically

    • addPendingReminder

      public static void addPendingReminder(int orderId)
      registers an order ID as pending so the 5-second upgrade task knows whether to replace the "queued" line or skip (if the order was already cancelled).
      Parameters:
      orderId - the newly booked order that will visit tomorrow

    • removeReminderForOrder

      public static void removeReminderForOrder(int orderId)
      removes the pending reminder for a cancelled order so the 5-second upgrade becomes a no-op, then erases the notification line from the sim log. safe to call from any thread.
      Parameters:
      orderId - the order that was just canceled

    • upgradeReminderToSent

      public static void upgradeReminderToSent(int orderId, String email, String parkName, String date, String time)
      called by the 5-second countdown in EchoServer. replaces the "queued" line with "✅ Reminder sent", unless the order was cancelled in the meantime, in which case removeReminderForOrder(int) already removed it from the pending set and this method returns silently. safe to call from any thread.
      Parameters:
      orderId - the order whose reminder is being confirmed
      email - the visitor's email address
      parkName - the name of the park
      date - the visit date string (yyyy-MM-dd)
      time - the visit time string (HH:mm)
